title: Lab - Explore the network environment
description: Read the network layout of a real cluster.
scenario: Read the network layout of a real cluster. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Nodes
tasks.instructions: How many nodes, what are their internal IPs, and which interface carries them?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get nodes -o wide
ip addr

tasks.title: Task 2 - Bridge
tasks.instructions: Which interface does the container runtime create on the node, and what is its MAC address?

tasks.title: Task 3 - Ports
tasks.instructions: Which port does the kube-scheduler listen on, and how many connections does etcd hold on 2379 vs 2380?
